findings.suggested_fix:
The translation consistently uses the Urdu word 'سنجیدگی' which commonly reads as 'seriousness' rather than the intended English meaning 'cynicism' or 'cynical attitude.' Consider using a more accurate Urdu term for 'cynicism' in both the title and the H2 heading. Suggested replacements (choose one consistent option):
- Title: "بدگمانی سے نمٹنا" and H2: "بدگمانی" or
- Title: "نفسِ بدگمانی سے نمٹنا" and H2: "بدگمانی (Cynicism)"
Apply the chosen term in both the <title> element and the corresponding <h2> to preserve consistency. Keep all HTML structure and other text unchanged.
